name: esbozo
description: Orquestador: un solo comando levanta backend + ventana de escritorio

scripts.dev: concurrently -k -n backend,desktop -c blue,green "npm --prefix backend run dev" "npm --prefix desktop run dev"
scripts.test:backend: npm run build --prefix backend && node --test backend/tests/*.test.mjs
scripts.test: npm run test:backend && npm run test:desktop
scripts.test:unit: npm run build --prefix backend && node --test backend/tests/postgres-tools.test.mjs backend/tests/technical-log.test.mjs && npm run test:desktop
